acceptance_evidence.admission_and_scope: Finite API01 commands with explicit capability/record/edge/author protection, immutable binding and current authority recheck. Future CAS tokens reject before admission; concurrent protection changes retain original CAS.
acceptance_evidence.durable_replay: Canonical request digest, global operation identity, fixed actor/workspace/class mapping and derived key persist before dispatch. Changed bytes conflict; exact replay does not refetch/overwrite mutable graph guards.
acceptance_evidence.unknown_and_local_fault: Real graph commit followed by deliberately discarded receipt recovers by identical node retry after agent expiry with one history entry. Real PostgreSQL outbox insertion failure leaves possible effect; exact retry confirms once without duplicate graph application.
acceptance_evidence.cancellation: Queued intent can be atomically rejected before first dispatch. Once reserved, cancellation cannot claim unsent; authority locks are released during HTTP and session revoke does not erase recorded possible effect.
acceptance_evidence.recovery_authority: Current enrolled node can inspect/retry only already associated attempt/session/generation IDs without a renewed agent credential or replacement graph payload. New expired/revoked agent writes refuse.
acceptance_evidence.outbox_and_created_grants: Scoped receipt and one stable confirmed-event outbox commit in the same local transaction; only confirmed findings grant optional creation-derived reads. Draft tasks and unknown outcomes do not.
acceptance_evidence.finite_storage_and_recovery: 4096 retained intents / 32MiB conservative logical reservation per attempt, cumulative creation quota, bounded request/receipt, finite dispatch retry/elapsed budget, fixed cursor membership and serialized 128-cursor quota. Exact replay/ID lookup remain available when new admission/cursor allocation overloads.
acceptance_evidence.all_five_public_mappings: Independent clean pinned graph qualification exercises finding creation, correction with lost receipt and stale-version refusal, informational add/remove with same-batch source CAS, and explicit structural draft remaining unapplied.
acceptance_evidence.native_draft_normalization: Captured public Draft materializes optional defaults; receipt validation accepts only ordered-plan equivalence after declared no-effect defaults and rejects non-default metadata/verification/title/CAS alterations. Stored submitted payload/key never change.
acceptance_evidence.postadmission_errors: No postcommit lookup in respond-async path. Postadmission response-size/storage faults preserve known identity and unknown/recovery semantics rather than false not_applied.

limits: One configured ordinary workspace service binding; operator must ensure mutation_actor_id matches the actual credential actor. No automatic privilege upgrade or alternate actor/key recovery.
A changed/revoked service binding or exhausted retry budget preserves unknown for manual reconciliation; it cannot mint a fresh key, prune uncertainty or overwrite a newer graph version.
Retained-intent byte reservation is canonical logical bytes plus fixed status/outbox allowance; PostgreSQL/index physical overhead requires installation storage policy.
Created-record grants are reads only, subject to frozen profile permission; final task lifecycle/completion policy belongs to AQ-10.
Confirmed outbox production is qualified; downstream playbook consumption is AQ-15, and provider/harness/client/product-scale qualification remains separate.
